messages:
anya: Heads-up: we need to roll out the updated exit data-retention appendix and a tiny manager microtraining next week.

julie: I can draft the handbook blurb. What's the short policy language we want?

olivia: Ops notes: exports must include name,email,employee_id,manager,last_login,primary_repo_access,device_serial. We should snapshot 24h before deprovision.

sam: Managers need a 10-15min recorded walkthrough + a one-line checklist they must confirm after an exit. Tracking: manager, employee_id, opt-in Y/N, training watched Y/N.

anya: Proposed handbook sentence: "On separation, Redwood will delete personal account data within 30 days unless a legal hold or security investigation requires retention; backups/logs may be retained up to 12 months for investigatory purposes. Employees will be offered an opt-in for short-term investigatory retention. Managers will receive a short checklist and must complete the recorded microtraining."

julie: Nice. I'll add a short FAQ and the e-sign opt-in wording.

olivia: Quick CLI example for infra to run export before deprovision:
```
redwood-admin export --user 3091 --fields name,email,employee_id,manager,last_login,primary_repo_access,device_serial --output /tmp/offboard-3091.csv
```

anya: Great. HR bot, please set a reminder to publish the draft and schedule the recording session.

hr-bot: Reminder set 026-05-01 09:00 PT: publish exit retention appendix and schedule manager microtraining recording.

sam: One small ask: make the manager checklist an inline slide + one-click acknowledgement so we can track completions automatically.

julie: Will do. Posting draft to #people-ops-docs for review in an hour. :thumbsup:
